profile.title: Storage Profiles
profile.subtitle: Where Media Intake stages downloads, and which libraries it feeds.
profile.emptyBody: A profile names a staging folder and the libraries imports land in. Media Intake does nothing until one exists.
profile.name: Name
profile.stagingHelp: Where downloads are held while they are checked. Must not sit inside a library, or a scanner will index half-written files.
profile.strategyHelp: Automatic picks the cheapest method the storage supports, preferring a hardlink so the torrent keeps seeding.
profile.moveWarning: Move deletes the source, so the torrent stops seeding. It is never chosen automatically.

strategy.provider_relocation: Ask the download client to move it
